title: Nested SQL casts retain intermediate precision and formatting
summary: Calcite preserved the four SCOTT.EMP display strings. The nested truncating cast now returned 6.6, matching the separately fetched and rebound VARCHAR.

change.description: The simplifier preserves an intermediate cast when removing it would alter the final conversion, including text formatting and truncation.

notes: Fetching and rebinding the intermediate prevents the optimizer from eliding it across the two statements. 20/3 has additional fractional digits before truncation.
